title_original: Nick Cave and India Pavilion Win Widely Boycotted Venice Biennale Awards
excerpt_original: The festival replaced its Golden Lions with new public-decided “Visitors’ Lions” after its jury resigned en masse in the fallout of a decision to exclude Israel and Russia from prizes.

blocks.text: After dozens of artists at the 61st Venice Biennale withdrew from award consideration in solidarity with the jury, which planned to omit Russia and Israel from the prizes and later resigned, the festival has announced Chicago-based artist Nick Cave and India's national pavilion as winners of its new visitors’ awards.

Nine days before the Venice Biennale opened on May 9, the women-led awards jury resigned en masse, shortly after announcing that countries facing accusations of crimes against humanity by the International Criminal Court, notably Israel and Russia, would not be eligible for prizes.

The Biennale reversed the decision soon after the jury's resignation and replaced the traditional jury-selected Golden and Silver Lion awards with the “ Visitors' Lions ,” voted on by ticket-holders and awarded to the most popular pavilion and artist.
